sourceQuotes.zh: 新蔡武哀王騰，字元邁，少拜冗從僕射，封東嬴公，曆南陽、魏郡太守，所在稱職，徵為宗正，遷太常，轉持節、寧北將軍、都督并州諸軍事、并州刺史。
sourceQuotes.en: Sima Teng, Prince Wuai of Xincai, courtesy name Yuanmai, was appointed Supernumerary Cavalier Attendant when young and enfeoffed as Duke of Dongying. He served successively as governor of Nanyang and Wei Commandery, was praised as competent wherever he served, was summoned as Director of the Imperial Clan, promoted to Minister of Ceremonies, and then transferred as Bearer of the Staff, General Who Pacifies the North, commander of all military affairs in Bing Province, and inspector of Bing Province.

sourceQuotes.zh: 惠帝討成都王穎，六軍敗績。
sourceQuotes.en: Hui's expedition against Sima Ying collapsed.

sourceQuotes.zh: 騰與安北將軍王浚共殺穎所署幽州刺史和演，率眾討穎。
sourceQuotes.en: Teng joined Wang Jun executing He Yan then marched on Ying.

sourceQuotes.zh: 穎遣北中郎將王斌距戰，浚率鮮卑騎擊斌，騰為後系，大破之。
sourceQuotes.en: Xianbei cavalry under Wang Jun shattered Wang Bin while Teng held the rear.

sourceQuotes.zh: 穎懼，挾帝歸洛陽，進騰位安北將軍。
sourceQuotes.en: Ying was afraid and took Emperor Hui back to Luoyang; Teng was promoted to General Who Pacifies the North.

sourceQuotes.zh: 莊王確，字嗣安，曆東中郎將、都督豫州諸軍事，鎮許昌。
sourceQuotes.en: Sima Que, Prince Zhuang, styled Si'an, successively served as General of the Gentlemen of the Household of the East and supervised the military affairs of Yu Province, stationed at Xuchang.

sourceQuotes.zh: 無子，初以章武王混子滔奉其祀，其後復以汝南威王祐子弼為確後。
sourceQuotes.en: He had no sons. At first Tao, son of Hun, Prince of Zhangwu, was appointed to maintain his sacrifices; afterward Bi, son of You, Prince Wei of Runan, was made Que's heir.

sourceQuotes.zh: 太興元年薨，無子，又以弼弟邈嗣確，位至侍中。
sourceQuotes.en: In the first year of Taixing, Bi died without sons. His younger brother Miao was then made Que's successor and rose to Palace Attendant.
Huang inherited as supernumerary cavalry attendant.

sourceQuotes.zh: 桓溫廢武陵王，免晃為庶人，徙衡陽。
sourceQuotes.en: Huan Wen's coup reduced Huang to commoner exile in Hengyang.

sourceQuotes.zh: 孝武帝立晃弟崇繼邈後，為奴所害，子惠立。
sourceQuotes.en: Chong continued Miao yet fell to household slaves; Hui followed.
